items.title: What's on This Page
items.why:
The Eras look is built with all 68 pictures you approved. Buzz shows up in the same places Goku does in the Dragon Ball look.

1. Where the art shows (one check).
2. Five word choices.
3. Whether to publish.

Nothing is published yet. The Dragon Ball look is unchanged; I checked it side by side.

items.title: Where Buzz Shows Up
items.why:
Same places as the Dragon Ball art: setup coach, workout moments, Pro Tips, the rest-day card, the streak ring around the profile picture, the menu icons, the friendship bracelets, the finale, the 9,000 moment and the profile pictures. Light and dark both work.

Only phones with someone on the Eras look download its pictures (about 1.6 MB, once), so Rob's and Lennon's phones stay light.

now.caption: Home: ring around Buzz, Eras icons

items.title: The Look's Name
items.why: Shown in Settings → Look and on the profile. It's called Encore now.

items.why: The pictures are friendship bracelets. The word was "charms" before the art existed.

items.title: The Big Reward
items.why: When all seven bracelets are gathered, the giant snake rises and she makes one wish.

items.title: Streak Savers
items.why: A saved rest day that keeps a streak alive. Dragon Ball calls them Senzu beans; this look calls them rain checks. The picture beside the streak is the pink heart bead.

options.label: Rain checks (keep)
options.desc: Says what it does: a day off that doesn't break the streak.

items.title: Streak Ring Names
items.why:
The ring around the profile picture grows with the streak, like Super Saiyan levels. Each level has a name, like "Super Saiyan 2". It's the ring's label: a computer shows it when the mouse rests on the ring, and a phone's screen reader reads it aloud:

7 days: Gold sparkle
14 days: Pink sparkle
21 days: Confetti
30 days: Ruby glitter
60 days: Midnight stars
100 days: Iridescent

items.title: The 9,000 Moment
items.why: Shows once, the first time her score passes 9,000. In this look the score is called Crowd.

items.title: Publish 2.28.0?
items.why: After your picks I build them, run every check (including the full audit on both looks), then publish. Nothing on anyone's phone is erased by this update.
